description: Bundle of named definitions; select a $defs reference to validate a document. Validation subject/report v1-foundation are partial self-contained inputs/diagnostics; production authority is absent and reports cannot authorize activation. Planner, validation and mutation handoffs are m0 drafts. Retail facts use retail-v2; reference calibration and price pairs remain DRAFT. Recipe authored snapshots use recipe-v1; culinary grounded inputs remain DRAFT. V1 substitutions are mass-only; preparation yield is net and path-specific. Plan intent v1/v2 unchanged; v3 sealed authoritative culinary intent; independent grounding companion; culinary generation v1 expands authored demand only, no downstream grounding/ranking; candidate grounding v1 resolves supported primitives, not feasibility/authority; Pareto shortlist v1-draft compares exact optional supply coverage only, not full portfolio/ranking or global feasibility; explicit preferences v1 record raw member assertions, no EvidenceStrength or utility; exposure preview v1 captures selected current proposals only, not consumption history; recipe cooldown v1-draft assesses one proposal using explicit policy, not global safety; decay trace v1-draft interprets eligible witnesses AS_OF_CAPTURE, no aggregate utility; repeat penalty v1-draft uses exact proposal-local policy units, not global history; PRECOMMIT authority not installed. No production activation or full independent validation is provided. Inventory-v1 physical commands/facts are explicit confirmation only; no projections. Physical snapshot and batch-flow handoffs remain DRAFT, not activation-ready. Cross-field semantic guards run in Python, not JSON Schema alone.
title: Menuto M0 domain contracts — draft handoffs, no business HTTP endpoints
